name: Sanballat
summary: Sanballat the Horonite was an enemy of Nehemiah who mocked the Jews and tried to stop them from rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem. He plotted to harm Nehemiah, but the wall was finished.

key_moments.title: Mocking the Builders
key_moments.description: Hearing that the Jews were building the wall, Sanballat grew furious and mocked them. Before the army of Samaria he asked what these feeble Jews thought they were doing.

key_moments.title: Plots to Attack Jerusalem
key_moments.description: When Sanballat, Tobiah and others heard that the gaps in Jerusalem's walls were being closed, they plotted to come and fight against the city. The people prayed and set a guard day and night.

key_moments.title: Tries to Lure Nehemiah to Ono
key_moments.description: Sanballat and Geshem asked Nehemiah to meet them in the plain of Ono, meaning to harm him. Nehemiah said he was busy with a great work and would not come down, even when Sanballat sent a letter accusing him of planning to rebel.
